title: 第9章 流浪两年获得李存孝第10章 恐怖的疯人院惊天密谋
slug: 全球守护灵开局获得东皇帝俊
content_zh:
“为了获得食物，年仅七岁的小天。”
“开始游离于此时混乱无比，到处充满争斗与恶灵的现代城市之中寻找着食物。”
“时不时的还要与其他，寻找食物的人，争夺食物而大打出手。”
“若不是小天从小就，拥有无双神力，身躯坚硬如铁，又从小习武，练就了一身不弱的本事。”
“恐怕根本就，无法在这次危机之中存活下来。”
“但即便拥有一身不弱的实力，小天的身上，每天依旧都会增添新的伤口。”
“可小天一个人寻找到的食物，根本无法满足那几百张嘴。”
“在这种情况下，赢氏一族的老人与残疾人，开始拒绝进食。”
“想要将食物全部留给那些，赢氏一族的新生一代。”
“无论小天如何劝阻，依旧无法改变他们的决定。”
“没几天，这些本就弱不禁风的老弱病残，就倒在了避难所中…”
“就在这时，悲痛的情绪，让小天本就处于觉醒状态中的天运帝眸，彻底觉醒。”
“天运帝眸的觉醒，瞬间就让黑绳九重巅峰的小天，连破一个瓶颈和五个小境界，进入了众合五重。”
“天运帝眸拥有：辨忠奸，分善恶，知祸福，通命运，晓气运。”
“破万法，吞万物，推天机，引天罚，过目不忘等等能力。”
“在天运帝眸觉醒后，小天开始将这些倒在了避难所内的，族人全部安葬。”
“将族人全部安葬完后，小天便带着五十几多个，四五岁的族人组成了负责寻找食物的小团队。”
“而剩下三十多个四五岁的族人，则负责留下来保护，照顾那些年纪，一二岁的族人。”
“安排妥当后，小天开始靠着天运帝眸的能力，在城市中寻找食物。”
“在天运帝眸的帮助下，小天和那些孩子们，每次出去都能躲避各种危险，带回大量的食物。”

“现在避难所里，终于不用愁没有食物了，可那些倒下的族人们，却再也回不来了。”
“这也成为了小天的一处心病。”
“这样平静的日子，持续了半个多月，便再次被打破。”
“原因便是，小天他们这段时间内，每次都能带回大量食物，还没有危险的消息被发现了。”
“天下没有不透风的墙。”
“哪怕小天十分的谨慎，还是被一些人给注意到了。”
“很快这些贪婪的人，便将手伸向了，小天他们这些没有成人庇护的孩子身上。”
“一群人很快便找到了，小天他们的庇护所内。”
“想要夺取小天他们的食物以及安全获取寻找食物的能力。”
“可这些能为食物发愁，并把手伸向孩子的家伙，如何能是小天的对手。”
“很快便被小天一人给打退了回去。”
“在将这些人打跑后，小天便开始带着年幼的族人们，离开了这个避难所。”
“前往了其他区域，继续带着族人们生存。”
“有了上一次的经历，小天他们都不会在一个地方，生活超过半个月。”
“就这样，在不停更换庇护所的时间里，小天他们在这战乱的时代下，还算安稳的度过了半年。”
“而在这半年中，冥界也是风起云涌。”
“所有被袭击了大后方的势力，在得知消息后，全部都愤怒的联合了起来。”
“在小天他们逃出去的几天后，就发起了对于恶灵的总攻。”
“在各大势力的协作下，很快恶灵的气焰，便被压了下去。”
“无数恶灵强者以及恶灵组成的势力全都被灭掉。”

“这场各大势力与恶灵的战争持续了半年之久，终于以恶灵的失败告终。”
“恶灵一方受到了，前所未有的巨大重创。”
“随后恶灵开始退散，缩紧了战线。”
“在恶灵退散后，以免恶灵的拼死反扑，各大势力也不敢对恶灵逼得太紧。”
content_en:
"In order to get food, Xiaotian, who was only seven years old."
"Start wandering around in this modern city that is extremely chaotic, full of fights and evil spirits, looking for food."
"From time to time, we have to fight with other people looking for food to compete for food."
"If Xiaotian hadn't possessed unparalleled divine power since he was a child, his body was as hard as iron, and he had practiced martial arts since he was a child, and he had developed strong skills."
"I'm afraid we simply won't be able to survive this crisis."
"But even with strong strength, Xiaotian still has new wounds added to his body every day."
"But the food Xiaotian found alone cannot satisfy those hundreds of mouths."
"In this case, the elderly and disabled people of the Ying clan began to refuse to eat."
"I want to leave all the food to those, the new generation of the Ying clan."
"No matter how much Xiaotian tries to dissuade them, they still can't change their decision."
"In a few days, these old, weak, sick and disabled people who were already extremely fragile fell into the shelter..."
"At this moment, the emotion of grief caused Xiaotian's Tianyun Emperor's Eyes, which was already in an awakening state, to completely awaken."
"The awakening of Tianyun Emperor's Eyes instantly allowed Xiaotian, who was at the peak of the ninth level of the Black Rope, to break through one bottleneck and five small realms, and enter the fifth level of Zhonghe."
"The Emperor's Eyes of Tianyun possess the following powers: Distinguish between loyal and traitorous, distinguish between good and evil, know misfortunes and blessings, understand destiny, and know luck."
"Ability to break all laws, swallow all things, push heaven's secrets, attract heaven's punishment, have photographic memory, etc."
"After Tianyun Emperor's Eyes awakened, Xiaotian began to bury all the clan members who had been dumped in the shelter."
"After burying all the clan members, Xiaotian took more than fifty clan members, four or five years old, to form a small team responsible for looking for food."
"The remaining thirty or so tribesmen who are four or five years old are responsible for staying to protect and take care of those tribesmen who are one or two years old."
"After the arrangements were made, Xiaotian began to rely on the ability of Tianyun Emperor Eye to look for food in the city."
"With the help of Emperor Tianyun, Xiaotian and the children can avoid various dangers and bring back a lot of food every time they go out."
"Now in the shelter, we finally don't have to worry about running out of food, but those fallen tribesmen will never come back."
"This has also become a worry for Xiaotian."
"Such a peaceful day lasted for more than half a month, and then it was broken again."
"The reason is that Xiaotian and the others have brought back a lot of food every time during this period, and no dangerous news has been discovered yet."
"There is no airtight wall in the world."
"Even though Xiaotian was very cautious, some people still noticed him."
"Soon these greedy people reached out to children like Xiaotian who had no adult protection."
"A group of people quickly found Xiaotian and their shelter."
"I want to take away Xiaotian and the others' food and their ability to find food safely."
"But how can these guys who worry about food and reach out to their children be Xiaotian's opponents?"
"He was quickly pushed back by Xiaotian alone."
"After beating these people away, Xiaotian began to take the young tribesmen and leave the shelter."
"He went to other areas and continued to lead his people to survive."
"After the last experience, Xiaotian and the others will not live in the same place for more than half a month."
"In this way, while constantly changing shelters, Xiaotian and the others spent half a year in peace in this war-torn era."
"And in the past six months, the underworld has also been turbulent."
"All the forces that were attacked in the rear area united in anger after learning the news."
"A few days after Xiaotian and the others escaped, they launched a general attack on the evil spirits."
"With the cooperation of all the major forces, the evil spirit's arrogance was soon suppressed.""Countless powerful evil spirits and forces composed of evil spirits have all been wiped out."
"This war between the major forces and the evil spirits lasted for half a year, and finally ended with the defeat of the evil spirits."
"The evil spirits have suffered an unprecedented heavy blow."
"Then the evil spirits began to retreat and tighten their front."
"After the evil spirits have dispersed, all major forces will not dare to push the evil spirits too hard to avoid a desperate counterattack."
